recentZipSample.caveat: Limit without representative sampling was overwhelmingly Walmart and cannot estimate national competitor or ZIP coverage.

currentDaySample.caveat: Production U.S. extraction must explicitly filter COUNTRY = 'USA'; row-limited sample is not a coverage estimate.

EDLDB.ECOM.ORDER_LINE.restriction: Schema only. Do not export raw order, customer, pet, subscription, or address identifiers. An approved destination-geography aggregate is still required.

EDLDB.CHEWYBI.ORDER_LINE_COST_MEASURES_P.interpretation: Pricing onboarding documents this as a Vertica table. Do not infer a Snowflake permission gap from this lookup.

EDLDB.MKT_SOLUTIONS_SANDBOX.BIDCOIN_METR.interpretation: Optional Marketing attribution source; not a Pricing-pilot blocker.

EDLDB.PDM.PROMOTIONS.interpretation: Phoenix Promotions examples use EDLDB.PDM.PROMOTION (singular) and CDM promotion-usage tables. Test those before inferring a permission gap.
